look_here_first: Look for a low rhizomatous perennial forming spreading colonies, with wavy or toothed leaves and small white flowers that fade pink to red.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis — UT herbarium specimen index under Gaura sinuata. Williamson — UT county flora treatment under Oenothera sinuosa. Gillespie — Enchanted Rock flora documents Oenothera sinuosa.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Historical Gaura sinuata records are mapped to current Oenothera sinuosa.

best_field_traits: rhizomatous perennial forming mats or colonies
foliage mostly glabrous to sparsely hairy
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with O. suffrutescens, O. sinuosa is generally greener and less densely gray-hairy, with longer-stipitate fruits.
